review_candidates.title: Project Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role will be responsible for the end-to-end management of industrial and infrastructure projects, from planning and production through site installation, testing, and handover, with clear accountability for project cost, timeline, quality, and overall execution. Responsibilities: Lead assigned projects from contract award through engineering, procurement, production, installation, testing, commissioning, and final handover. Develop, maintain, and control detailed project schedules using Mic
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Monitor engineering drawings, material submittals, procurement requirements, production progress, inspections, deliveries, installation, and site activities to ensure all project functions remain aligned. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 7+ years of project management experience, preferably within steel fabrication, industrial, infrastructure, water, construction, or EPC environments. Proficiency in working with AI tools is required.
